Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 5 minutes Number of Servings: 16 Ingredients 1 can (15 ounces) diced tomatoes 1/4 cup onion, chopped (1/4 medium onion or 2 green onions, chopped including green tops) 1 clove garlic, chopped or 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder 1 lime, squeezed for juice 1 can (4 ounces) diced green chiles 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, loosely packed Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Combine ingredients, except cilantro, in a blender. Blend to the thickness you like. Finely chop cilantro and stir into other ingredients. Serve immediately or refrigerate in airtight container for up to 1 week. Notes: No blender? Make a chunky salsa by cutting all ingredients to desired size before mixing. Try adding drained canned corn or black beans with cilantro. Make ahead to allow flavors to blend. Freeze extra lime juice to use later.
